title: Make edit-tool matching independent of CRLF versus LF line endings
before: At parent 65fb9116, the edit tool compared oldText directly with raw file content using includes, split, and indexOf. An LF-only oldText therefore did not match equivalent text stored with Windows CRLF line endings. Replacement output and diffs also operated directly on raw content.
after: At c214a334, the edit tool detects the file's line-ending style, normalizes file content, oldText, and newText to LF for matching, uniqueness checks, replacement, and diff generation, then converts the completed content back to the detected CRLF or LF style before writing. LF-only model input can edit CRLF files while ordinary CRLF and LF files retain their respective line-ending styles.
diff: Added detectLineEnding, normalizeToLF, and restoreLineEndings helpers. Reworked existence checks, occurrence counting, index calculation, replacement, and no-op detection to use normalized strings. Restored the detected file style at the write boundary and generated diffs from normalized content. Simplified the success message by removing raw character counts. Added four tests covering LF input against CRLF content, CRLF preservation, LF preservation, and duplicate detection across mixed CRLF/LF variants.
call_sites: The changed edit implementation is used by the default mutable coding tool set, the all-tools map, and working-directory-specific createCodingTools/createAllTools factories, so the normalization applies to standard agent edit operations without call-site changes.
tests: A regression test writes CRLF content and invokes editTool with LF-only oldText/newText, asserting that the edit succeeds.
Regression tests read the resulting files and assert that a CRLF file remains entirely CRLF after editing and an LF file remains LF.
A regression test creates logically duplicated text using one CRLF occurrence and one LF occurrence, then verifies that normalized uniqueness checking reports two occurrences.

title: Decode Win32 folder-picker paths without a fixed-size unmanaged view
before: The Win32 directory-picker binding decoded the NUL-terminated UTF-16 path returned by IShellItem::GetDisplayName by creating a fixed 32,768-byte Koffi external view, scanning that view for a two-byte NUL terminator, and converting the prefix with Buffer.toString('utf16le'). The fixed view neither represented the allocation's actual size nor supported paths whose encoded data exceeded 32 KiB.
after: The binding serializes the BigInt native string address into an eight-byte buffer, restricts the buffer to the process pointer width reported by koffi.sizeof('void *'), and passes that pointer variable to koffi.decode(..., 'str16'). The resultPath path still frees the original GetDisplayName address with CoTaskMemFree and releases the shell item. Tests cover four- and eight-byte pointer preservation, the original release address, BMP characters with zero low bytes, surrogate pairs, NUL termination, and strings longer than 32 KiB using real Koffi decoding over live test-owned buffers.
diff: Removed Koffi.view from the local binding interface and replaced the fixed external-memory view plus manual UTF-16 terminator scan with pointer-width native Koffi string decoding. Threaded the already-derived pointerSize into readUtf16. Reworked the fake Koffi environment around numeric BigInt addresses and pointer buffers, added assertions for pointer-width serialization and COM deallocation, and added real-Koffi resultPath cases for representative UTF-16 and long-string behavior. Added a bilingual implementation note recording the decoding and ownership constraints.
call_sites: loadWin32DialogBindings derives pointerSize with koffi.sizeof('void *'), passes it to readUtf16 in resultPath, then frees the unchanged GetDisplayName address with CoTaskMemFree and releases the IShellItem in finally.

runFolderDialog consumes dialog.resultPath after a successful Show, checks its HRESULT, and returns the decoded path to the directory-picker caller while retaining dialog and COM cleanup in finally blocks.
tests: Parameterized fake-Koffi tests exercise both four-byte and eight-byte BigInt addresses, assert that the decoder receives the matching pointer-buffer width, and assert that CoTaskMemFree receives the original address.

Real-Koffi resultPath tests decode live UTF-16 buffers containing zero-low-byte BMP code units, a surrogate pair, more than 32 KiB of text, and an embedded NUL; they compare the serialized pointer before native dereference and verify deallocation and COM cleanup.

title: Route remaining Hermes runtime data paths through HERMES_HOME
before: Although hermes_cli.config.get_hermes_home() already resolved HERMES_HOME with ~/.hermes as its fallback, numerous CLI, gateway, agent, environment, and tool paths bypassed it by constructing Path.home() / ".hermes" or expanding ~/.hermes directly. Tests now configure HERMES_HOME and assert that session discovery and clipboard image storage use that directory.
